title: Packaged offerings, pricing tiers, and entitlement matrix for public cloud marketplaces
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Define and finalize a marketplace-friendly product packaging strategy (hosted API, Dedicated, Private) plus pricing tiers and an entitlement matrix for AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace. Deliverables: a canonical SKU/entitlement table, marketing-friendly package descriptions, billing mapping for each cloud storefront, a rollback-safe launch checklist, and a localization handoff for legal and regional pricing. This ticket coordinates PM, finance, legal, engineering (billing & metering), and design artifacts required for submission and post-launch telemetry.
notes: 2026-02-22: Kickoff meeting with finance and legal to align on revenue recognition constraints for reserved capacity (Liam). Action: finance to provide potential pricing bands and margin targets by 2026-02-27.

2026-02-28: Engineering scoped required metering events for Dedicated and Private SKUs. ENG-6220 to implement usage metering hooks. Blockers: short list of telemetry fields missing from runtime (ENG-4821).
2026-03-03: Design delivered two promotional tile variants and condensed feature bullets for each package. Need marketing sign-off on language and GDPR-compliant copy (DES-141).

2026-03-05: Legal requested three changes to the terms: clearer data residency language for Private, a clarified SLA exception for scheduled maintenance, and a simplified refund policy for marketplace purchases. Legal doc link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketplace/legal-packaging-2026 (internal).
2026-03-07: PM reviewed integration test plan for billing mappings in staging for AWS and GCP. Action: QA to run end-to-end purchase-to-entitlement tests on 2026-03-20.
2026-03-09: Cross-cloud price parity analysis completed — recommended list prices published to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketplace/pricing/packaged-offerings-2026.xlsx

2026-03-10: Decided to include a lightweight free-trial SKU (30-day credits) for hosted API only; Dedicated/Private will have trial via sales. Rationale: reduce marketplace churn and align with existing self-serve credit flow. (Decision logged by Ava).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SKU/entitlement table completed and reviewed by finance/legal/eng (file: drive link above)
Marketplace listing copy (AWS/Azure/GCP) finalized and localized for EN/DE/FR by localization team
Billing mapping implemented in staging and validated via end-to-end test cases (purchase -> activation -> metering events)
risks: Marketplace billing cadence mismatch could delay revenue recognition — mitigated by finance-approved mapping and PR for billing adapters (ENG-4821).
Legal localization delays for region-specific terms (DE/FR) could block submission to specific marketplaces — mitigation: parallel reviews and prioritized legal reviewers.
Unauthorized pricing misalignment between marketplaces (list vs. committed pricing) — mitigation: single source of truth spreadsheet + release gating by PM.
rollout_plan: Week 1: Finalize SKU table, legal terms sign-off, and localized copy
Week 2: Engineering to instrument metering and entitlement activation in staging; QA runs E2E tests
Week 3: Submit listings to AWS/Azure/GCP and monitor approval queues; prepare rollback artifacts
Week 4: Post-approval smoke tests and early telemetry collection; enable marketing asset syndication
